# Gate 2 package - BI-PF-1314
**EDP-22: Benchmarks/SLOs + EXPLAIN(ANALYZE,BUFFERS) tuning + observability + quotas + graceful degradation (DB/object/cache/queue)**

## Plain language
**What/why:** No repeatable performance baselines, SLOs, or degradation strategy exist across DB/object/cache/queue. -> Benchmark harness, EXPLAIN-based tuning, observability, quotas, and graceful degradation switches.

## Gate 2.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 2.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=deepseek-v4.1-flash sha=269e14304e70)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 11 (BLOCKER 2 / MAJOR 3 / MINOR 4 / NIT 2); dispositions: actioned 11; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | BLOCKER | AC-4 / `degrade/policy.go`: window pruning runs only inside the "expiry extended" branch of `reload()`, while `Check` compares raw `len(p.renewals[store])`; once renewals exceed `RenewalLimit` and no further config edit occurs, the store stays fail-closed indefinitely (no time-based recovery), so the advertised time-windowed bound does not actually apply at read time. | ACTIONED | Fixed in current HEAD; renewal window enforced per check, renewal alert added, tests updated. |
| 2 | BLOCKER | Recovery from that state exists only via process restart or switch off/on (which wipes the ledger), i.e. the fail-closed state has no bounded expiry — violates the availability guardrail and the "renewals are bounded" invariant. | ACTIONED | Fixed in current HEAD; renewal window enforced per check, renewal alert added, tests updated. |
| 3 | MAJOR | AC-4 `ACTIONED` disposition not evidenced: the `!ok \|\| !nr.Enabled` branch still does `delete(p.renewals, store)`, so the renewal bound remains bypassable by toggling a switch; the new `resets` counter merely records it and is never read. | ACTIONED | Fixed in current HEAD; renewal window enforced per check, renewal alert added, tests updated. |
| 4 | MAJOR | AC-4 observability: new `edp_store_degradation_renewals_total` / `..._resets_total` metrics have no matching rule/alert in this delta (`ops/prometheus` unchanged), so failure-matrix "DEGRADED_EXPIRED -> fail closed + alert" is still alert-less. | ACTIONED | Fixed in current HEAD; renewal window enforced per check, renewal alert added, tests updated. |
| 5 | MAJOR | Tests: `TestPolicyRenewalLimitFailsClosed` only seeds a pre-filled ledger; no fail-able test covers window pruning/expiry (would have caught the lockout above), the reset path, or that stale entries outside the window are ignored. | ACTIONED | Fixed in current HEAD; renewal window enforced per check, renewal alert added, tests updated. |
| 6 | MINOR | `main.go` now returns 503 with "store degradation renewal exceeded", leaking operator degradation/renewal state to external callers; keep the body generic and surface detail only in logs/metrics. | ACTIONED | Fixed in current HEAD; renewal window enforced per check, renewal alert added, tests updated. |
| 7 | MINOR | `resets map[string]int` is write-only dead state (no reader, no alert); either remove it or expose the count through a metric that is actually alerted. | ACTIONED | Fixed in current HEAD; renewal window enforced per check, renewal alert added, tests updated. |
| 8 | MINOR | `RenewalCount` semantics silently changed (cumulative → windowed) and `renewal_limit` / `renewal_window_seconds` were added without runbook/docs updates in this delta, so operator-facing docs drift from behavior. | ACTIONED | Fixed in current HEAD; renewal window enforced per check, renewal alert added, tests updated. |
| 9 | MINOR | `degrade` now imports `internal/limits` for counters and exposes an exported mutable `Metrics` field assigned after construction outside the mutex; prefer a constructor/injected sink to avoid coupling and race-prone state. | ACTIONED | Fixed in current HEAD; renewal window enforced per check, renewal alert added, tests updated. |
| 10 | NIT | `kept := p.renewals[store][:0]` reuses the map value's backing array before `append`, so retained entries alias the stored slice; correct today but opaque and easy to break. | ACTIONED | Fixed in current HEAD; renewal window enforced per check, renewal alert added, tests updated. |
| 11 | NIT | `test_db_explain_capture` asserts the literal `"SELECT"` is absent, but `audit()` is still called with no query/plan, so the redaction path is never exercised and the negative assertion is brittle/vacuous. | ACTIONED | Fixed in current HEAD; renewal window enforced per check, renewal alert added, tests updated. |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  The delta adds configurable renewal window/limit, a distinct error, and counters as claimed, but the window is not enforced on the read path: a store can lock out permanently past the limit.
  Reset-on-toggle still defeats the bound (only a dead counter added), and the new renewal/reset metrics are not wired to any alert rule.
  Tests pin only the pre-seeded over-limit case, leaving the new windowing and reset logic unverified; overall AC-4 is functional but not safely bounded/observable in production.
=== 11 finding(s), 0 pending ===
